senses.gloss:
रेज् 1. रेज् [cf. rt. 1. राज्], cl. 1. A. रेजते
(Ved. also P. रेजति), &c., to shine; to
shake, tremble, quiver, flicker (Ved.); to cause to
tremble or shake (Ved. P.); (according to Naigh. II.
14) to go (P.): Caus. रेजयति, &c., to cause to
tremble or quake, to shake.

2. रेज्, ट्, ट्, ट्, shining; shaking, a shaker; (ट्),
m., N. of Agni or fire.
रेजमान, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. quaking, trembling.
